graduation_criteria.description: Discovery → Deployment 전환 조건. discovery_graduation_gate.sh 강제. v8.x WS2 재설계(2026-05-29): rank-IC 계열은 long-only 실현 alpha와 어긋나(16후보 calibration 실측: rank_ic가 FLOW 거짓탈락+NN/TECH 거짓통과) advisory로 강등, portfolio-alpha t(forge NW lag-3)를 hard로. DSR hard는 sweep형 selection만(2026-06-10 개정 — chain/단일은 advisory). hard 기준은 forge-authoritative 값(alpha-stage proxy 아님)에 적용.
graduation_criteria.min_rank_ic_rationale: KR top-universe benchmark. <0.04는 IC 약함. (v8.x severity=advisory — long-only 실현 alpha 미전이)
graduation_criteria.max_drawdown_days_rationale: 100일 이상 drawdown 지속 시 alpha decay 의심. (severity=advisory)
graduation_criteria.min_harvey_t_stat_rationale: rank-IC Harvey-t. (v8.x severity=advisory — rank-IC t는 portfolio-alpha t와 구분, 후자가 권위)
graduation_criteria.min_deflated_sharpe_ratio_rationale: Bailey-Lopez de Prado DSR — multi-testing 보정 SR. (severity=HARD는 sweep형 selection만 — ML스윕/optimizer서치/앙상블·사전등록 grid. 가설주도 chain/단일검증은 advisory 강등+진단산출. 도훈 mandate 2026-05-31/2026-06-10, measurement-graduation §3)
graduation_criteria.min_portfolio_alpha_t_nw_rationale: ★v8.x 신규 HARD. forge-authoritative 실현 portfolio-alpha t (NW lag-3, forge_package.portfolio_alpha_t_nw_lag3). Harvey-Liu-Zhu 2016 hurdle. rank-IC t 아님. 게이트 핵심 판별(16후보 중 FLOW만 통과=정확).
graduation_criteria.severity_rationale: hard = block(우회불가), advisory = warn(screening). hard 2종(DSR/portfolio_alpha_t_nw)은 forge-authoritative 값에만 적용 — alpha-stage proxy로 graduation 선언 금지(v8.x WS1 정합).

hypothesis_description:
FROM exhaustive momentum-hunt workflow (kr-novel-momentum-hunt: 52 concepts -> ranked). C21_Flow_Confirmed_Revision = TOP total (4.60), Tier-A, NON-return-derived. FULL build-ready spec at stage_artifacts/momentum_hunt/backlog.json -> specs[name='C21_Flow_Confirmed_Revision'] (construction, estimator, lookback_grid, data_inputs, pit_notes C1-C15, orthogonality_targets, build_steps 1-12, honest_risks). READ IT and follow.

CONCEPT: Interaction (product of cross-sectional z-scores) of analyst EPS up-revision (consensus: eps_chg_1m + esbr) CONFIRMED by smart-money flow (Foreign+Institutional 20d net-buy / Size). Combines TWO non-return information sets -- neither touched by any M* factor. Mechanism: a revision that informed investors are NOT buying is stale/priced; one they ARE buying carries incremental info (revision-drift arbitraged faster when flow present). The PRODUCT captures conditional info that a linear combo of the two marginals misses.

WHY THIS ESCAPES THE DEAD-END: the 3 prior failures (FIP/Hurst/PCDM) were all FUNCTIONS OF RETURNS -> KR return-momentum is spanned by M01/M08/M24. C21 uses consensus + flow, both NON-return information sources, so it has structural room to carry orthogonal predictive content.

KEY BUILD POINTS (full detail in backlog.json spec): variants P(raw product) / G(gated = z_rev * max(z_flow,0)) / S(signed-floor); flow_window {20d,60d}; revision_leg {eps_only, esbr_only, blend 0.5/0.5}; top_n {15,20,25}; anchor cell = G/20d/blend. Cross-sectional z_safe_winsorize per sig_date (no full-sample). CRITICAL incrementality test: prove orthogonality vs INV08_Foreign_Inst_Agreement / C19_Composite_Earnings / INV10_Smart_Money_Flow AND that the interaction beats M_linadd (simple linear add of the two marginals): if rho_active(C21, M_linadd) >= 0.85 OR delta-PORT_t <= 0, report honestly that the interaction adds nothing -- but note the two marginals each remain non-return and M-cluster-orthogonal (residual value).

EXPECTED_ROLE: core/offensive NON-return alpha combining consensus + flow conditional information. WHY_NOW: PG0 sleeve_needs=core_alpha; return-derived momentum exhausted (3 failures, see [[project-kr-momentum-novel-hunt]]); flow + consensus are the untapped orthogonal axes (workflow ranked all top-7 as non-return flow/consensus/liquidity).

PIT/CONSTRAINTS: per spec pit_notes (C1 no full-sample z; C2 Date<=sig_date, forward Ret_1m separated; C4 consensus already lagged; C10 ADV t-1; C13 Z_Score_Aligned; C14; C15). long-only ONLY, KR, max 25, weight bounds [0,0.20], 15bps delta cost, production liquidity 2e8 for deployable screen. real-computation ONLY (canonical_screen_bt); proxy hand-calc forbidden. Codex Critic Round mandatory.

HONEST RISK (AX-000 / AX-007): interaction may collapse to linear-add (flow & revision co-react to same news); graduation NOT presumed; real-but-non-graduating -> screen-route (OVERLAY/FR/DPL). rawdata BM_Ret empty -> rebuild benchmark from .cache/benchmark.parquet (real KOSPI200 TR). R segfault guard (single-thread, kill stray Rscript, file-based). This is concept #1 of a sequential exhaustive campaign through the ranked backlog.
